blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Starting from three x plus two equals eleven, which of these could be the next line? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Starting from 3x + 2 = 11, which of these could be the next line? Select all that apply.

blocks.text: Three x equals nine. Two was subtracted from both sides, so this line follows.
Six x plus four equals twenty-two. Both sides were multiplied by two, so this line follows.
Three x equals thirteen. Two was added to the right side instead of subtracted, so this line does not follow.
X plus two equals eleven over three. Only the three x was divided by three, so this line does not follow.
Three x plus two equals nine. Two was subtracted from one side only, so the sides are no longer equal.
Two lines follow: three x equals nine, and six x plus four equals twenty-two. Each one does the same thing to both sides.
